verses.sloka: तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्त्ववान् हरिसत्तमः ।वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम् ।। ५.५१.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samīkṣya mahāsattvaṁ sattvavān harisattamaḥ ।vākyamarthavadavyagrastamuvāca daśānanam ।। 5.51.1।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, looking at the very powerful Ravana spoke slowly these highly meaningful words.

verses.sloka: अहं सुग्रीवसन्देशादिह प्राप्तस्तवालयम् ।राक्षसेन्द्र हरीशस्त्वां भ्राता कुशलमब्रवीत् ।। ५.५१.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ sugrīvasandeśādiha prāptastavālayam ।rākṣasendra harīśastvāṁ bhrātā kuśalamabravīt ।। 5.51.2।।।।

translations.english: "O lord of demons I reached your realm here by the orders of Sugriva, lord of monkeys who is like your brother. He conveys his good wishes to you.
translations.hindi: जलती हुई श्रौर विध्वस्त लंका को तथा भयभीत राक्षसों को देख, हनुमानजी सोचने सगे

verses.sloka: भ्रातुः शृणु समादेशं सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।धर्मार्थोपहितं वाक्यमिह चामुत्र च क्षमम् ।। ५.५१.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhrātuḥ śṛṇu samādeśaṁ sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।dharmārthopahitaṁ vākyamiha cāmutra ca kṣamam ।। 5.51.3।।।।

translations.english: "The great Sugriva who is like your brother sends you a message pertinent to this world and the other world, that which is beneficial and consistent with righteousness and propriety (धर्म and अर्थ). Listen:
translations.hindi: सोचते-सोचते उनके मन में बड़ा भय उत्पन्न हो गया और वे भ्रपनी निन्दा कर कहने लगे कि, यह मैंने क्या किया जो लंका को फूँक दिया

verses.sloka: राजा दशरथो नाम रथकुञ्जरवाजिमान् ।पितेव बन्धुर्लोकस्य सुरेश्वरसमद्युतिः ।। ५.५१.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma rathakuñjaravājimān ।piteva bandhurlokasya sureśvarasamadyutiḥ ।। 5.51.4।।।।

translations.english: "There was an emperor named Dasaratha richly endowed with chariots, horses and elephants. He was a friend to the world and was like a father and equal to Indra in splendour.
translations.hindi: ये पुरुषश्रेष्ठ धन्य हैं, जो समझ बुझ कर उपजे हुए क्रोध को उसी प्रकार ठंडा कर डालते हैं; जिस प्रकार दहुकती हुई श्राग को

verses.sloka: ज्येष्ठस्तस्य महाबाहुः पुत्रः प्रियकरः प्रभुः ।पितुर्निर्देशान्निष्क्रान्तः प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम् ।। ५.५१.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: jyeṣṭhastasya mahābāhuḥ putraḥ priyakaraḥ prabhuḥ ।piturnirdeśānniṣkrāntaḥ praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam ।। 5.51.5।।।।

translations.english: "His eldest son, a highly effulgent one, named Rama who was dear to the king, accepting his father's orders went into exile with brother Lakshmana and wife Sita also accepting a righteous path and entered Dandaka forest.
translations.hindi: क्रोध के वशवर्ती लोग क्या नहीं कर डालते । क्रोध के भ्रावेश में लोग झपने पूज्यों को मार डालते हैं श्रौर क्रोध में भर लोग सज्जनों को भी कूवाक्य कहु बैठते है

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा सीतया चापि भार्यया ।रामो नाम महातेजा धर्म्यं पन्थानमाश्रितः ।। ५.५१.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā sītayā cāpi bhāryayā ।rāmo nāma mahātejā dharmyaṁ panthānamāśritaḥ ।। 5.51.6।।।।

translations.english: "His eldest son, a highly effulgent one, named Rama who was dear to the king, accepting his father's orders went into exile with brother Lakshmana and wife Sita also accepting a righteous path and entered Dandaka forest.
translations.hindi: क्रुद्ध होने पर मनुष्य को कहनी भ्रनकहुनी बात का विवेक नहीं रहता । क्रोधी के लिए न तो कोई भ्रनकरना काम ही है और न भ्रनकहनी कोई बात ही है

verses.sloka: तस्य भार्या वने नष्टा सीता पतिमनुव्रता ।वैदेहस्य सुता राज्ञो जनकस्य महात्मनः ।। ५.५१.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya bhāryā vane naṣṭā sītā patimanuvratā ।vaidehasya sutā rājño janakasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 5.51.7।।।।

translations.english: "Sita, daughter of king Janaka of Videha kingdom, loyally followed her husband, Rama. She was lost in the forest.
translations.hindi: किन्तु जो भ्रादमी क्रोध श्राने पर उसको क्षमा द्वारा वैसे ही निकाल बाहर करता है जेसे सपं पुरानी केंचुल को, वही झादमी ; श्रादमी कहलाने योग्य है

verses.sloka: स मार्गमाणस्तां देवीं राजपुत्रः सहानुजः ।ऋश्यमूकमनुप्राप्तः सुग्रीवेण समागतः ।। ५.५१.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa mārgamāṇastāṁ devīṁ rājaputraḥ sahānujaḥ ।ṛśyamūkamanuprāptaḥ sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ ।। 5.51.8।।।।

translations.english: "Searching for the divine lady the prince reached mount Rshyamuka along with his brother and there he met Sugriva.
translations.hindi: धिक्कार है मुझ बड़े भारी दुर्बुद्धि, निलंज्ज श्रौर पापी को, जिसने सीता का ध्यान न रख लंका जला डाली और उसके साथ ही भ्रपने स्वामी को भी नष्ट कर डाला ग्रथवा स्वामी का बना बनाया काम बिगाड़ डाला

verses.sloka: तस्य तेन प्रतिज्ञातं सीतायाः परिमार्गणम् ।सुग्रीवस्यापि रामेण हरिराज्यं निवेदितम् ।। ५.५१.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tena pratijñātaṁ sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam ।sugrīvasyāpi rāmeṇa harirājyaṁ niveditam ।। 5.51.9।।।।

translations.english: "Sugriva promised Rama to undertake search for Sita and Rama assured Sugriva of securing him the kingdom of the monkeys.

verses.sloka: ततस्तेन मृधे हत्वा राजपुत्रेण वालिनम् ।सुग्रीवः स्थापितो राज्ये हर्यृक्षाणां गणेश्वरः ।। ५.५१.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastena mṛdhe hatvā rājaputreṇa vālinam ।sugrīvaḥ sthāpito rājye haryṛkṣāṇāṁ gaṇeśvaraḥ ।। 5.51.10।।।।

translations.english: "Then prince Rama killed Vali in battle and made Sugriva, king of the vanaras and bears and restored the kingship of Sugriva.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि, यदि यह सारी की सारी लंका जल गई तो सती सीता जी भी अवश्य ही भस्म हो गई होंगी । मेने भ्रज्ञानवश स्वामी का काम ही बिगाड़ डाला ।। &॥ यदर्थेसयमारस्भस्तत्कार्यसवसादितस्‌ । सया हि दहता लङ्कां न सीता परिरक्षिता

verses.sloka: त्वया विज्ञातपूर्वश्च वाली वानरपुङ्गवः ।रामेण निहतः सङ्ख्ये शरेणैकेन वानरः ।। ५.५१.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvayā vijñātapūrvaśca vālī vānarapuṅgavaḥ ।rāmeṇa nihataḥ saṅkhye śareṇaikena vānaraḥ ।। 5.51.11।।।।

translations.english: "You know of Vali, chief of the vanaras, in the past. Rama killed him with a single arrow in the combat.
translations.hindi: इसमें सन्देह नहीं कि, लंका का जलना एक मामूली काम था, किन्तु मने तो क्रोधान्ध होकर मूल ही का नाश कर डाला

verses.sloka: स सीतामार्गणे व्यग्रः सुग्रीवः सत्यसङ्गरः ।हरीन् संप्रेषयामास दिशः सर्वा हरीश्वरः ।। ५.५१.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa sītāmārgaṇe vyagraḥ sugrīvaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ ।harīn saṁpreṣayāmāsa diśaḥ sarvā harīśvaraḥ ।। 5.51.12।।।।

translations.english: "Sugriva, who is true to his word and a faithful warrior, king of monkeys anxiously sent vanaras in all directions for searching Sita.
translations.hindi: जब लंका का कोई भी स्थान नजला नहीं दीख पड़ता भौर समस्त लंका- पुरी भस्म हो गई है; तब निइचय ही जानकीजी भी भस्म हो गई हैं

verses.sloka: तां हरीणां सहस्राणि शतानि नियुतानि च ।दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते ह्यधश्चोपरि चाम्बरे ।। ५.५१.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāṁ harīṇāṁ sahasrāṇi śatāni niyutāni ca ।dikṣu sarvāsu mārgante hyadhaścopari cāmbare ।। 5.51.13।।।।

translations.english: "Hundreds, thousands and unlimited number of monkeys are searching (for Sita) in all directions, in the underworld and heavens and the sky.
translations.hindi: यदि मैने ्रपनी नासमझी से कार्य नष्ट कर डाला है, तो मुझे यहीं पर अपना प्राण त्याग करना ठीक जान पड़ता है

verses.sloka: वैनतेयसमाः केचित् केचित्तत्रानिलोपमाः ।असङ्गगतयः शीघ्रा हरिवीरा महाबलाः ।। ५.५१.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: vainateyasamāḥ kecit kecittatrānilopamāḥ ।asaṅgagatayaḥ śīghrā harivīrā mahābalāḥ ।। 5.51.14।।।।

translations.english: "Some of the very powerful heroes equal to Garuda, equal to the Windgod (in swiftness) have gone (in quest of Sita) without touching the earth.

verses.sloka: अहं तु हनुमान्नाम मारुतस्यौरसः सुतः ।सीतायास्तु कृते तूर्णं शतयोजनमायतम् ।। ५.५१.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tu hanumānnāma mārutasyaurasaḥ sutaḥ ।sītāyāstu kṛte tūrṇaṁ śatayojanamāyatam ।। 5.51.15।।।।

translations.english: "I, Maruta's son, Hanuman by name too came swiftly leaping across a hundred yojanas across the ocean searching for Sita.
translations.hindi: क्या में भ्रग्नि में गिर कर भस्म हो जाऊं श्रथवा समुद्र के वडवानल में कूद पड़े भ्रथवा समुद्रवासी जलचरों को श्रपना शरीर दे डालू ।। १४ कथं हि जीवता शक्यो मया द्रष्टु हरीश्वरः । तौ वा पुरुषशाद्लौ कार्यसर्वस्वघातिना

verses.sloka: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वैव तां दिदृक्षुरिहागतः ।भ्रमता च मया दृष्टा गृहे ते जनकात्मजा ।। ५.५१.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: samudraṁ laṅghayitvaiva tāṁ didṛkṣurihāgataḥ ।bhramatā ca mayā dṛṣṭā gṛhe te janakātmajā ।। 5.51.16।।।।

translations.english: "While I was roaming I saw Janaka's daughter Sita at your house.You are a knower of the truth of righteousness. You are very wise and carrried out great austerities. It does not behove you to abduct another man's wife.
translations.hindi: तीनों लोकों में यह बात प्रसिद्ध है कि, वानर के स्वभाव का क्या ठीक--सो मैंने क्रोध के श्रावेश में भ्रा, इस लोकोक्ति को चरितार्थं कर के दिखला दिया

verses.sloka: तद्भवान् दृष्टधर्मार्थस्तपः कृतपरिग्रहः ।परदारान् महाप्राज्ञ नोपरोद्धुं त्वमर्हसि ।। ५.५१.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadbhavān dṛṣṭadharmārthastapaḥ kṛtaparigrahaḥ ।paradārān mahāprājña noparoddhuṁ tvamarhasi ।। 5.51.17।।।।

translations.english: "While I was roaming I saw Janaka's daughter Sita at your house.You are a knower of the truth of righteousness. You are very wise and carrried out great austerities. It does not behove you to abduct another man's wife.
translations.hindi: सुन्दरकाण्डे घिगस्तु राजसर्भावमनीशसनवस्थितस्‌ । "ईश्वरेणापि यद्रागान्सया सीता न रक्षिता ॥। १७ राजसिकभाव ग्रर्थात्‌ रजोगुण को धिक्कार है. जो लोगों को मनमुखी श्रौर अव्यवस्थित बना देता है। मेने सामर्थ्यं रहते भी रजोगुण से प्रेरित हो, सीता की रक्षा न की

verses.sloka: न हि धर्मविरुद्धेषु बह्वपायेषु कर्मसु ।मूलघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः ।। ५.५१.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hi dharmaviruddheṣu bahvapāyeṣu karmasu ।mūlaghātiṣu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvidhāḥ ।। 5.51.18।।।।

translations.english: "Indeed, respectable people and wise men like you should not indulge in actions opposed to righteousness as it will strike at the very root of your existence.

verses.sloka: कश्च लक्ष्मणमुक्तानां रामकोपानुवर्तिनाम् ।शराणामग्रतः स्थातुं शक्तो देवासुरेष्वपि ।। ५.५१.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: kaśca lakṣmaṇamuktānāṁ rāmakopānuvartinām ।śarāṇāmagrataḥ sthātuṁ śakto devāsureṣvapi ।। 5.51.19।।।।

translations.english: "Who, even among gods and asuras can withstand the arrows released by Lakshmana in obedience to the infuriated Rama's orders?

verses.sloka: न चापि त्रिषु लोकेषु राजन् विद्येत कश्चन ।राघवस्य व्यलीकं यः कृत्वा सुखमवाप्नुयात् ।। ५.५१.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: na cāpi triṣu lokeṣu rājan vidyeta kaścana ।rāghavasya vyalīkaṁ yaḥ kṛtvā sukhamavāpnuyāt ।। 5.51.20।।।।

translations.english: "O king there is none in these three worlds who can enjoy happiness by displeasing Rama.
translations.hindi: घमिष्ठ इक्ष्वाकुवंश का नाश हो जाने पर निस्सन्देह सारी प्रजा शोक- सन्ताप से पीड़ित हो जायगी

verses.sloka: तत्त्रिकालहितं वाक्यं धर्म्यमर्थानुबन्धि च ।मन्यस्व नरदेवाय जानकी प्रतिदीयताम् ।। ५.५१.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tattrikālahitaṁ vākyaṁ dharmyamarthānubandhi ca ।manyasva naradevāya jānakī pratidīyatām ।। 5.51.21।।।।

translations.english: "Think that my advice is beneficial to you for you present, past and future. It is righteous. It will provide you material wealth too. Hence return Sita to the lord of the people.
translations.hindi: भ्रतः निश्चय ही में हतभागी हूं श्रौर रोष-दोष से भरा हुआ हूं जो इस खोक का नाशक है। मेरा जो कुछ उपाजित धर्मार्थ था वह भी सुप्त हो गया । भ्रथवा में बड़ा भ्रभागा हूं । मने क्रोध के वशवर्ती हो उस धर्मार्थ को भी नष्ट कर डाला, जिसके नष्ट होने से परलोक भी विनष्ट हो जाता है

verses.sloka: दृष्टा हीयं मया देवी लब्धं यदिह दुर्लभम् ।उत्तरं कर्म यच्छेषं निमित्तं तत्र राघवः ।। ५.५१.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭā hīyaṁ mayā devī labdhaṁ yadiha durlabham ।uttaraṁ karma yaccheṣaṁ nimittaṁ tatra rāghavaḥ ।। 5.51.22।।।।

translations.english: "I have actually spotted the divine lady here which was most difficult. Rama will plan the remaining course of action.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार हूनमानजी चिन्ता में मग्न थे कि, इतने में उनको विविष प्रकार के शुभ शकुन जो पहिले भी देख पड़े थे, देख पड़े; तब तो बे पुन सोचने लगे

verses.sloka: लक्षितेयं मया सीता तथा शोकपायणा ।गृह्य यां नाभिजानासि पञ्चास्यामिव पन्नगीम् ।। ५.५१.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: lakṣiteyaṁ mayā sītā tathā śokapāyaṇā ।gṛhya yāṁ nābhijānāsi pañcāsyāmiva pannagīm ।। 5.51.23।।।।

translations.english: "I have seen Sita immersed in deep sorrow. You do not realise that by abducting her you are keeping a fivehooded female serpent in your house.
translations.hindi: सर्वाङ्गशोभना श्रौर सौभाग्यवती जानकी श्रपने पातिग्रत घर्म-पालन के प्रभाव से सदेव सुरक्षित हैं, वह कमी नष्ट नहीं हो सकतीं । क्योंकि भ्रग्नि अला श्रग्नि को क्या जलावंगा

verses.sloka: नेयं जरयितुं शक्या सासुरैरमरैरपि ।विषसंसृष्टमत्यर्थं भुक्तमन्नमिवौजसा ।। ५.५१.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: neyaṁ jarayituṁ śakyā sāsurairamarairapi ।viṣasaṁsṛṣṭamatyarthaṁ bhuktamannamivaujasā ।। 5.51.24।।।।

translations.english: "Just as food mixed with venom cannot be digested by the great fire (fire of hunger), it is not possible to keep Sita even by gods and demons. (Sita is like food mixed with poison. Ravana cannot digest her with all his power.)
translations.hindi: फिर भ्रतुल तेजस्वी घर्मात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की पत्नी को जो श्रपने पातिव्रत घमं से सुरक्षित हैं, भ्रग्नि स्पर्श नहीं कर सकता

verses.sloka: तपस्सन्तापलब्धस्ते यो ऽय धर्मपरिग्रहः ।न स नाशयितुं न्याय्यमात्मप्राणपरिग्रहः ।।। ५.५१.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tapassantāpalabdhaste yo 'ya dharmaparigrahaḥ ।na sa nāśayituṁ nyāyyamātmaprāṇaparigrahaḥ ।।। 5.51.25।।।।

translations.english: "You have acquired the merit of righteousness by prolonged hardships experienced during your penance. It is not proper to forfeit your own life in this way.
translations.hindi: तभी तो श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के प्रताप श्रौर सीताजी के पुण्य-प्रभाव से जलाने वाले भ्रग्नि ने मुझे नहीं जलाया--यह बात निश्‍चय है

verses.sloka: अवध्यतां तपो ऽभिर्यां भवान् समनुपश्यति ।आत्मनः सासुरैर्देवैर्हेतुस्तत्राप्ययं महान् ।। ५.५१.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: avadhyatāṁ tapo 'bhiryāṁ bhavān samanupaśyati ।ātmanaḥ sāsurairdevairhetustatrāpyayaṁ mahān ।। 5.51.26।।।।

translations.english: "You know you will not be killed by asuras or gods. In that case also this (keeping Sita with you) may be the prime cause of your death.
translations.hindi: जो भरतादि तीनों भाइयों की देवता है भ्रौर श्रीरामचन्ब्रजी की प्राण- वल्लभा है, भला वह कंसे नष्ट होगी

verses.sloka: सुग्रीवो न हि देवो ऽयं नासुरो न च राक्षसः ।न दानवो न गन्धर्वो न यक्षो न च पन्नगः ।तस्मात् प्राणपरित्राणं कथं राजन् करिष्यसि ।। ५.५१.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīvo na hi devo 'yaṁ nāsuro na ca rākṣasaḥ ।na dānavo na gandharvo na yakṣo na ca pannagaḥ ।tasmāt prāṇaparitrāṇaṁ kathaṁ rājan kariṣyasi ।। 5.51.27।।।।

translations.english: "Sugriva is not an demon, nor a danava nor gandharva, nor a yaksha nor even a pannaga. Therefore how can you save your life from Sugriva?
translations.hindi: घुङ्खरकाण्डे डे त अथवा सब वस्तुभ्रों को जलाने की सामथ्यं रखने वाले ध्रौर नाशरहित भ्रग्नि ने, जब मेरी पूछ ही को नहीं जलाया, तब वे सती सीता को किस प्रकार भस्म करेंगे

verses.sloka: न तु धर्मोपसंहारमधर्मफलसंहितम् ।तदेव फलमन्वेति धर्मश्चाधर्मनाशनः ।। ५.५१.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: na tu dharmopasaṁhāramadharmaphalasaṁhitam ।tadeva phalamanveti dharmaścādharmanāśanaḥ ।। 5.51.28।।।।

translations.english: "The fruit of dharma does not accrue to one who has reached the culmination of adharma. Unrighteousness will destroy the fruits of righteousness.
translations.hindi: तदुपरान्त सोच-विचार कर, फिर हनुमानजी श्रीसीताजी के प्रभाव से, समुद्र के बीच हिरण्यनाम मैनाकपवंत के निकल धराने की सुधि कर, विस्मित हो गए प्रोर मन ही मन कहने लगे

verses.sloka: प्राप्तं धर्मफलं तावद्भवता नात्र संशयः ।फलमस्याप्यधर्मस्य क्षिप्रमेव प्रपत्स्यसे ।। ५.५१.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: prāptaṁ dharmaphalaṁ tāvadbhavatā nātra saṁśayaḥ ।phalamasyāpyadharmasya kṣiprameva prapatsyase ।। 5.51.29।।।।

translations.english: "There is no doubt you have earned merit through righteousness (dharma destroys adharma and yields sweet fruit ultimately). But now you will quickly reap the result of your unrighteousness also.

verses.sloka: जनस्थानवधं बुद्ध्वा बुद्ध्वा वालिवधं तथा ।रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च बुद्ध्यस्व हितमात्मनः ।। ५.५१.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: janasthānavadhaṁ buddhvā buddhvā vālivadhaṁ tathā ।rāmasugrīvasakhyaṁ ca buddhyasva hitamātmanaḥ ।। 5.51.30।।।।

translations.english: "You know about the killing of all ogres at Janasthana and of Vali also. You know about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. You may decide on a proper course of action for the sake of your own welfare.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी इस प्रकार सीताजी की घर्मनिष्ठा को सोच ही रहे थे कि, इतने में हनुमानजी को महात्मा चारणों के ये वचन सुन पड़े

verses.sloka: कामं खल्वहमप्येकः सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् ।लङ्कां नाशयितुं शक्तस्तस्यैष तु न निश्चयः ।। ५.५१.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ khalvahamapyekaḥ savājirathakuñjarām ।laṅkāṁ nāśayituṁ śaktastasyaiṣa tu na niścayaḥ ।। 5.51.31।।।।

translations.english: " Alone, I can destroy this entire Lanka teeming with horses, chariots and elephants. Indeed I have the energy but not the mandate of Sri Rama.
translations.hindi: प्राहा निश्चय हो हनुमानजी ने बड़ा ही दुष्कर काम कर डाला कि राक्षसों के घरों में भयंकर भ्राग लगा दी

verses.sloka: रामेण हि प्रतिज्ञातं हर्यृक्षगणसन्निधौ ।उत्सादनममित्राणां सीता यैस्तु प्रधर्षिता ।। ५.५१.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmeṇa hi pratijñātaṁ haryṛkṣagaṇasannidhau ।utsādanamamitrāṇāṁ sītā yaistu pradharṣitā ।। 5.51.32।।।।

translations.english: "Rama made a vow in the presence of bears and vanaras that he would exterminate the arrogant enemy troops by whom Sita is abducted and assaulted.
translations.hindi: जिससे राक्षसों की स्त्रियां, बालक, बूढ़े, सब घबड़ा कर भाग खड़े हुए प्रौर बड़ा कोलाहल मचा और लंकापुरी पर्वत की कन्दरा की तरह कोलाहल से प्रतिष्वनित हो गई

verses.sloka: अपकुर्वन् हि रामस्य साक्षादपि पुरन्दरः ।न सुखं प्राप्नुयादन्यः किं पुनस्त्वद्विधो जनः ।। ५.५१.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: apakurvan hi rāmasya sākṣādapi purandaraḥ ।na sukhaṁ prāpnuyādanyaḥ kiṁ punastvadvidho janaḥ ।। 5.51.33।।।।

translations.english: "Indra, the destroyer of enemy citadels cannot live happily if he offends Rama. What to speak of persons like you?
translations.hindi: प्रटारियों, प्राकारों श्रौर तोरणद्वारों सहित, सारी की सारी लंका भस्म कर दी, किन्तु हमको यह बड़ा भ्राश्‍चरयं जान पड़ता है कि, जानकी न जली

verses.sloka: यां सीतेत्यभिजानासि येयं तिष्ठति ते वशे ।कालरात्रीति तां विद्धि सर्वलङ्काविनाशिनीम् ।। ५.५१.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāṁ sītetyabhijānāsi yeyaṁ tiṣṭhati te vaśe ।kālarātrīti tāṁ viddhi sarvalaṅkāvināśinīm ।। 5.51.34।।।।

translations.english: "Sita who is under your custody is no ordinary lady. She is indeed the dark night of dissolution, destroyer of entire Lanka. Know this.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी पूर्व में ग्रनुभत शुमफलप्रद शुभशकुनों को देख ग्रौर ऋषियों (चारणों) के उपयूक्त वाक्यों को सुन, मन ही मन बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: तदलं कालपाशेन सीताविग्रहरूपिणा ।स्वयं स्कन्धावसक्तेन क्षममात्मनि चिन्त्यताम् ।। ५.५१.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadalaṁ kālapāśena sītāvigraharūpiṇā ।svayaṁ skandhāvasaktena kṣamamātmani cintyatām ।। 5.51.35।।।।

translations.english: "Stop holding the noose of death in Sita's form whom you yourself have placed on your shoulders. Think of your own welfare.
translations.hindi: चारण लोगों के वचनों से सीताजी के शरीर को कुशल जान. हनुमानजी का मनोरथ पूरा हुआ । फिर सीताजी को भ्रपनी ग्राँखों से प्रत्यक्ष (सकुशल) देख, हनुमानजी ने लंका से लोटने का निश्चय किया

verses.sloka: सीतायास्तेजसा दग्धां रामकोपप्रपीडिताम् ।दह्यमानामिमां पश्य पुरीं साट्टप्रतोलिकाम् ।। ५.५१.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: sītāyāstejasā dagdhāṁ rāmakopaprapīḍitām ।dahyamānāmimāṁ paśya purīṁ sāṭṭapratolikām ।। 5.51.36।।।।

translations.english: "Visualize this city of Lanka including its marketplaces and main streets as burnt by Sita's power of chastity and Rama's anger.

verses.sloka: स्वानि मित्राणि मन्त्रीश्च ज्ञातीन् भ्रातऽन् सुतान् हितान् ।भोगान् दारांश्च लङ्कां च मा विनाशमुपानय ।। ५.५१.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: svāni mitrāṇi mantrīśca jñātīn bhrāta'n sutān hitān ।bhogān dārāṁśca laṅkāṁ ca mā vināśamupānaya ।। 5.51.37।।।।

translations.english: "Do not pave the path of your friends, ministers, clan, brothers and sisters, sons, wellwishers, wives and luxuries and Lanka to destruction.

verses.sloka: सत्यं राक्षसराजेन्द्र शृणुष्व वचनं मम ।रामदासस्य दृतस्य वानरस्य विशेषतः ।। ५.५१.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: satyaṁ rākṣasarājendra śṛṇuṣva vacanaṁ mama ।rāmadāsasya dṛtasya vānarasya viśeṣataḥ ।। 5.51.38।।।।

translations.english: "O king of demon listen to the words of truth of the servant of Rama, his messenger and specially a vanara.

verses.sloka: सर्वान्लोकान् सुसंहृत्य सभूतान् सचराचरान् ।पुनरेव तथा स्रष्टुं शक्तो रामो महायशाः ।। ५.५१.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvānlokān susaṁhṛtya sabhūtān sacarācarān ।punareva tathā sraṣṭuṁ śakto rāmo mahāyaśāḥ ।। 5.51.39।।।।

translations.english: "Illustrious Rama can put an end to and dissolve all creatures including both movable and immovables of all worlds. He can recreate all of them in the same way. He has such superhuman powers.

verses.sloka: देवासुरनरेन्द्रेषु यक्षरक्षोगणेषु च ।विद्याधरेषु सर्वेषु गन्धर्वेषूरगेषु च ।। ५.५१.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: devāsuranarendreṣu yakṣarakṣogaṇeṣu ca ।vidyādhareṣu sarveṣu gandharveṣūrageṣu ca ।। 5.51.40।।।।

translations.english: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.

verses.sloka: सिद्धेषु किन्नरेन्द्रेषु पतत्त्रिषु च सर्वतः ।। ५.५१.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: siddheṣu kinnarendreṣu patattriṣu ca sarvataḥ ।। 5.51.41।।।।

translations.english: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.

verses.sloka: सर्वभूतेषु सर्वत्र सर्वकालेषु नास्ति सः ।यो रामं प्रतियुद्ध्येत विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमम् ।। ५.५१.४२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvabhūteṣu sarvatra sarvakāleṣu nāsti saḥ ।yo rāmaṁ pratiyuddhyeta viṣṇutulyaparākramam ।। 5.51.42।।।।

translations.english: "He is equal to Visnu in valour. There is none who can dare face his rage, be it among gods, asuras, yakshas, rakshasas, vidyadharas, gandharvas uragas, siddhas, kings of kinnaras, birds and all beings at all places and at all times.

verses.sloka: सर्वलोकेश्वरस्यैवं कृत्वा विप्रियमुत्तमम् ।रामस्य राजसिंहस्य दुर्लभं तव जीवितम् ।। ५.५१.४३।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarvalokeśvarasyaivaṁ kṛtvā vipriyamuttamam ।rāmasya rājasiṁhasya durlabhaṁ tava jīvitam ।। 5.51.43।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is the supreme lord of all worlds, a lion among kings. Having pained him it is very difficult for you to sustain your life after offending him to this extent.

verses.sloka: देवाश्च दैत्याश्च निशाचरेन्द्र गन्धर्वविद्याधरनागयक्षाः ।रामस्य लोकत्रयनायकस्य स्थातुं न शक्ताः समरेषु सर्वे ।। ५.५१.४४।।।।
verses.transliteration: devāśca daityāśca niśācarendra gandharvavidyādharanāgayakṣāḥ ।rāmasya lokatrayanāyakasya sthātuṁ na śaktāḥ samareṣu sarve ।। 5.51.44।।।।

translations.english: "O king of demons, even devas, daityas, gandharvas, vidyadharas, nagas, and yakshas are incompetent to face Rama the lord of the three worlds in wars.

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूश्चतुराननो वा रुद्रस्त्रिनेत्रस्त्रिपुरान्तको वा ।इन्द्रो महेन्द्रः सुरनायको वा त्रातुं न शक्ता युधि रामवध्यम् ।। ५.५१.४५।।।।
verses.transliteration: brahmā svayambhūścaturānano vā rudrastrinetrastripurāntako vā ।indro mahendraḥ suranāyako vā trātuṁ na śaktā yudhi rāmavadhyam ।। 5.51.45।।।।

translations.english: "Even the selfborn, fourfaced Brahma, the threeeyed Siva who destroyed Tripura, Mahendra, the king of suras do not have the power to save one whom Rama decides to kill".

verses.sloka: स सौष्ठवोपेतमदीनवादिनः कपेर्निशम्याप्रतिमो ऽप्रियं वचः ।दशाननः कोपविवृत्तलोचनः समादिशत् तस्य वधं महाकपेः ।। ५.५१.४६।।
verses.transliteration: sa sauṣṭhavopetamadīnavādinaḥ kaperniśamyāpratimo 'priyaṁ vacaḥ ।daśānanaḥ kopavivṛttalocanaḥ samādiśat tasya vadhaṁ mahākapeḥ ।। 5.51.46।।

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana who was of matchless strength, hearing the unpleasant words of advice and warning expressed skilfully with dignity by the great Hanuman, enraged Ravana, his eyes rolling in anger ordered the execution of Hanuman. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
